svg.title: Models, local servers and integrations OASIS works with
svg.desc: Three scrolling rows. Hosted: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, any OpenAI-compatible API. Local: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, OmniRoute, FreeLLMAPI, zero-budget mode, failover backups, prompt caching, spend limits. Plugs into: MCP servers, MCP Registry, 48 app connectors, Claude Code plugins, Codex plugins, Gemini CLI extensions, skills, hooks, GitHub Action, A2A agents.
